liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Drums (1)** (1 review): The reviewer loves the Hendrix 'Waterfall' sample used during the drum solo [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-07-10.142467.schoeps.cmc4.mk2s.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 179 min [1]
- **gd1989-07-10.aud.andrewf.76249.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: The recording has extremely good balance despite the bad weather conditions; Vocals are over-saturated in spots, mainly noticeable in Franklin's Tower [2][22]
- **gd1989-07-10.153414.MTX.photoLeon.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 170 min [4]
- **gd1989-07-10.akg414s.alexander.79598.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 160 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [14]. Said about its sound: Wild cheers appear mid-song due to a huge downpour and loud thunder claps [24]

## Around the show

- Lightning struck the stadium rim while thousands of wet fans watched the rain [20]
- A tornado touched down ten miles south of New York City near the stadium [21]
- Fans in the third tier stayed dry during Music Never Stopped, then got drenched [21]
- Six inches of water covered the main floor where people danced and splashed [23]
- A friend's wife in the first row looked miserable enduring the torrential downpour [23]
- The football field became a bathtub, and the ground lifted under crowd clapping [24]
- The stadium was deluged during Music Never Stopped, starting around Tennessee Jed [26]
- Angry yellow jackets tried to restore order in the wet upper deck crowd [26]
- This show is all over the map, unlike the previous night's crazy-good sequences [28]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-07-10.142467.schoeps.cmc4.mk2s.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC4/MK2S mics spaced on stands, OTS > Panasonic SV-250 (16-bit/48k); Transfer Info: Dat… [1]. Also: Ted Mattes provided the master Dat recording for this specific audio source; Charlie Miller handled the transfer and coordinated the effort for this file [1]
- **gd1989-07-10.aud.andrewf.76249.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F; source: Nakamichi CM-300's with CP-4 shotgun capsules > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell UDXL-IIS 90's, with Dolby off. Mics on stand aprx eight feet high, with foam windscreens… [2]. Also: The tape was not paused between songs due to inclement weather conditions [2]
- **gd1989-07-10.153414.MTX.photoLeon.t-flac16**: source: A photoLeon Matrix [4]. Also: Dan Tepper recorded and transferred the AKG 414-BTL source for this matrix; Ted Mattes recorded the Schoeps CMC4/MK2S source, processed by Scott Clugston [4]
- **gd1989-07-10.akg414s.alexander.79598.flac16**: taped by Tim Alexander; transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: FOB (AKG 414s > Sony D5 (Dolby B) > MAC [14]. Also: Tim Alexander loaned his masters for this audience recording transfer [14]
